name: What is the average cost of a whole-house remodel in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a whole-house remodel in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a whole-house remodel in the Los Angeles area can vary widely, starting from approximately $150 per square foot for basic updates and potentially exceeding $400 per square foot for luxury, high-end renovations. This range depends on factors like the quality of materials, the extent of structural work, custom finishes, and the complexity of design. We provide a detailed estimate after understanding your project goals and conducting an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles, whole-house remodels typically range from $150 to over $400 per square foot, varying by material quality, structural work, and design complexity.
